name: Speedy Goncharov
source:
A surrealist visual novel exploring the mind of Andrey “The Banker” Daddano. Based on characters from the greatest mafia movie of all time. 

[From [url=https://globuggames.itch.io/speedy-goncharov]Itch.io[/url]]

Visual novel adaptation of a [url=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/goncharov]Tumblr meme[/url] about a non-existent movie directed by Martin Scorsese.
translation:
一部探索“银行家”安德烈·达达诺思想的超现实主义视觉小说。基于有史以来最伟大的黑手党电影中的角色。

[来自[url=https://globuggames.itch.io/speedy-goncharov]Itch.io[/url]]

视觉小说改编自 [url=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/goncharov]Tumblr meme[/url]，讲述一部由马丁·斯科塞斯 (Martin Scorsese) 执导的不存在的电影。
